summary: WidePoint Corporation filed an 8-K reporting its selection as the single awardee of the Department of Homeland Security's (DHS) Cellular Wireless Managed Services (CWMS) 3.0 contract, a 10-year IDIQ contract valued at approximately $3.1 billion. The filing is a routine current report disclosing entry into a material definitive agreement—a government contract—and does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spinoff, restructuring, or other special situation. No per-share price, premium, board recommendation, or special-situation mechanics are at play. This is a standard operational contract win, not a corporate event requiring special-situations classification.
